jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create a production transparent game sprite, ONE detached FRONT HEAD for X from Reverse:1999. Image 1 is the primary local portrait, identity and EXPRESSION reference. Image 2 is only the project's current RimWorld/Arknights pawn-style sheet; never copy their identity/accessories.
Translate X into the same simplified flat 2D pawn head style. Strict frontal view looking at viewer, head upright with NO portrait tilt. Head only: head/face/ears/hair, NO neck clothing, NO shoulders or torso, no hat, no halo, no jewelry invented.
Identity: youthful MALE, short voluminous smoky ash-grey hair with a muted lavender-grey cast, chunky swept layered locks, off-center crown part and curving forelocks over the forehead, fuller side-swept mass on viewer-right as in Image 1. Preserve main hair silhouette while using about 7-10 broad locks and few interior lines, not individual strands. Light warm skin as in the local portrait. HETEROCHROMIA: character RIGHT eye / viewer LEFT amber-gold with a small dark scleral surround as visible in Image 1; character LEFT eye / viewer RIGHT clear pale BLUE with normal light sclera. Both are compact pawn eyes with clear pupils, single upper lid and at most one tiny glint, not realistic anime eyes. Show enough of both irises to identify the different colors; do not swap colors or hide an eye completely.
EXPRESSION MUST MATCH Image 1: friendly, cheerful and slightly playful, relaxed lifted brows, small lightly OPEN smiling mouth with a tiny pink interior. Not stern, angry, sad, blank or smirking villain. Retain tiny visible nose mark and short gently tapered chin; no long pointed chin or infant round face. Smile stays small, not a huge laughing mouth.
Rendering: flat matte limited color patches, 2-3 restrained tones per material; heavy near-black outer silhouette, much weaker selective inner hair lines, game-scale readability. Outer silhouette thickness is designed to read about 3-4px when this whole hair-and-face head is reduced to ~86px width in a final 256px canvas. Facial marks remain much thinner. No pores, skin marks, freckles or scars (none obvious in local portrait), no glossy specular locks, gradient modeling, rim light or deep facial shading.
Composition: a single centered head, complete hair tips/ears/chin with generous transparent margins, square canvas, smooth clean transparent alpha. No text, border, watermark, checkerboard, background or extra views.

Use case: style-transfer. Production RimWorld pawn texture: ONE detached HEADLESS BODY of X from Reverse:1999, straight FRONT view, from tiny neck/collar connection to shoes. Image 1 is the primary local costume reference. Image 2 shows the existing pawn asset style and proportions; use it only for simplification and bold contour.
X is MALE in a LOOSE LONG LAB COAT. Prioritize the garment's hanging silhouette. No female waist cinch, no hourglass, no flared hips designed to suggest feminine anatomy. The torso is substantial and nearly straight beneath the loose coat. Shoulders naturally broad, coat panels hanging to lower calf, restrained hem volume, not a bell skirt. Compact squat pawn proportions, not long fashion-illustration proportions. Body silhouette should be roughly 1.6-1.8 times as tall as broad. Upper clothing about half of body height, close-together short legs/feet below.
IMPORTANT project anatomy: NO HEAD, NO HAIR, NO FULL ARMS OR HANDS. Omit the long sleeves entirely or leave only tiny shoulder sleeve-cap stubs. Do NOT draw any hanging sleeve tube, glove, hand, raised arm, book or clipboard.
Preserve these costume identifiers from Image 1 in simplified large shapes:
1) charcoal standing collar, small round brass clasp. Asymmetric charcoal shoulder-cape/chest flap primarily on character RIGHT (viewer LEFT), bearing the simple cream-and-muted-gold leaf/wing motif on front only.
2) loose ivory/light grey OPEN long coat with straight hanging front panels, dark outlined button row on viewer LEFT, visible patch pocket and tiny pen; light grey inner folds, no dense cloth texture.
3) dark grey inner broad-check waistcoat, mint/aqua cloth crossing chest and tied in a soft front bow with long two tails. Reduce checks to a few broad muted intersecting bands, not fine plaid.
4) character LEFT/viewer RIGHT purple vertical shoulder strap carrying a small charcoal rectangular instrument with a single pale ROUND dial, pale hanging ID badge on turquoise connector/cord. Keep the turquoise loop cord down that coat side, small purple tab at coat pocket. Badge can have a couple abstract marks, no tiny text.
5) near-black knee-length shorts under the opening, small silver waist-chain hint, small visible bare knee areas, charcoal high socks, brown buckle band on character RIGHT leg if visible, brown lace-up low shoes with dark toe tips. Feet close together and directed DOWN along legs; short toe, no outward splay or sideways flared feet.
Only existing attached accessories. No backpack, gun, belt arsenal, extra straps, wings, fur or effects.
Flat simplified 2D game texture with near-black bold outline equivalent to ~3-4px at final 256px export, subordinate partial internal lines, 2-3 matte tones per material, limited larger readable details, no shiny leather reflections, polished metal shine, smooth gradients, realism or dense detail. Preserve light coat/mint/purple accents, do not recolor to Vertin purple suit. Single complete body centered on square transparent canvas, clean alpha, all shoes and coat hem within frame, no text/title/checkerboard/ground shadow/background.

Use case: identity-preserve. A new directional texture for the SAME X character as image 1, the generated front head. Image 2 is the user's original portrait identity/expression reference. Image 3 is the local pawn style comparison, not a character identity source. Preserve the exact smoky ash/lavender-grey hair palette, broad side-swept layered hair construction, light warm face palette, youthful MALE identity and friendly playful smile. Simple RimWorld/Arknights 2D head-only asset with bold near-black silhouette, weaker interior hair lines, two or three matte colors per material. No glossy rendering or detailed hair strands. Tiny readable nose and natural small open smiling mouth when visible; short softly tapered chin, no exaggerated round baby face or long V chin. No invented freckles, scars or burns. NO headwear, halo, shoulders, torso, neck clothes. One head with clean transparent background and ample clear margins. No text, checkerboard, ground shadow, haze or additional panels.
VIEW: true RIGHT-FACING PROFILE, a strict side view, head upright, no tilt and no three-quarter second eye. We see character LEFT side, so the one visible iris is BLUE with light sclera. The golden right eye is on the far side and MUST NOT be shown. Keep the layered crown and soft swept fringe foreshortened toward the nose, visible simple left ear, short layered nape. Profile nose, small slightly open upturned smile and relaxed eyebrow match his pleasant cheerful expression; not stern or neutral. The blue pupil and small smile must read at game scale. Do not invent a ponytail/bun.

No face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, neck or neck clothing. No bun/ponytail. Do not paste the front fringe onto the rear; infer the rear of this short haircut conservatively. Similar width/height/outline weight to front.

Image 2 is the primary local full portrait; image 3 is ONLY the existing pawn rendering/pose reference. Use the front sprite's pale loose long lab coat, charcoal collar and asymmetric shoulder cape, broad grey checked inner vest, mint tied front cloth, purple left-shoulder instrument strap with rectangular round-dial device and ID badge/turquoise loop cord, black shorts, charcoal socks, brown low shoes. Color and garment length must correspond to image 1. MALE in loose outerwear: nearly straight hanging clothing silhouette, natural modest hem volume, NO cinched waist, hourglass, emphasized hips or tight feminine jacket. Compact squat pawn proportions, body height roughly 1.7-1.9 times its overall width. Bold near-black outer contour, subordinate limited inside lines, flat 2-3 tones per material, no specular shine or dense texture. NO head/face/hair and NO full arms/hands/long sleeves; only tiny shoulder caps if needed. No handheld book/clipboard or extra props/backpack/weapons. Feet compact and continuing downward along legs, short toes, no exaggerated heel/L-shaped ankle or outward splay. Single full body from small collar connection to shoes on clean transparent canvas, no background/haze/shadow/text/checkerboard.
VIEW: strict RIGHT-FACING PROFILE of the whole body, not three-quarter. It is character LEFT side that faces us: purple strap, chest instrument and hanging ID/teal loop are visible near the forward chest/side, foreshortened; do not duplicate them. The charcoal cape mainly covers the far RIGHT shoulder, so only its collar/rear extension and edge should appear; do not stamp the large FRONT gold leaf emblem in full onto the side. Front mint cloth only shows as a little foreshortened forward edge. Near white coat side panel and patch-pocket/side tab structure hang to lower calf. Original right-leg brown knee band may be occluded on far leg, not moved to the visible left leg.
POSE: neck anchor high on viewer RIGHT and lower legs/feet modestly toward viewer LEFT, a continuous thick forward slash / like the male pawn reference. Upper torso slightly forward, lower leg relation more slanted, smoothly joined, NOT a folded greater-than shape. Coat drapes over the form without waist indentation, leaves a substantial waist/chest section, no strong deep posterior waist concavity. Shoes tucked into the continuing leg direction, rounded short toe to right, no long horizontal shoe sole. Do not rotate the detached head (none in this part).

Rear of same loose calf-length coat, nearly straight flanks with slight natural opening toward hem; simple center seam and restrained back vent are conservative inferred construction. Black rear standing collar. Asymmetric charcoal shoulder cape belongs to character RIGHT, therefore it sits mostly on SCREEN RIGHT in this back view. Its back is plain charcoal, no copied front cream/gold emblem. Purple shoulder strap belongs to character LEFT, therefore its short visible back continuation is on SCREEN LEFT. Do NOT copy front gauge, ID badge, front bow, button row, pen pocket or chest chain onto the back; these front objects are hidden. No backpack, no new belts or decoration. A couple of muted coat folds, lower calf hem, compact visible sock bottoms and the backs of brown low shoes. No knee patches drawn through the coat. Keep coat length/palette/width and shoe baseline consistent with front. Shoes close together and point down, not sideways.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent headless right-facing body sprite for the RimWorld mod character X.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact edit target, our right-facing side body; image 2 is the approved front body, for continuity only; image 3 is the original local character portrait for physical-side evidence only.
Edit ONLY two small local areas of image 1:
1. Correct the visible character-left pocket. Remove the blue-and-gold pen completely: the original pen belongs on character-right, hidden on the far side in this view. Replace the large rectangular patch pocket outline with the original simple dark narrow angled pocket flap and its short muted-purple tab with a small pale rivet, as on the viewer-right of image 2. There must be NO extra pen and NO large rectangle dangling below this left flap. Continue the light coat fabric naturally below.
2. Shorten the shoe's forward-projecting toe and gather the rear heel. Make a compact short brown lace-up shoe with dark toe cap and thin sole that follows the same forward-slanting lower-leg axis. Reduce horizontal shoe extension roughly one quarter, retain brown color, small laces, dark toe cap, keep ankle thickness and ground baseline. Avoid an L-shaped ankle and broad horizontal foot.
Preserve everything else as closely as possible: same true right-facing profile, same continuous diagonal body pose with loose coat draping freely, same thick dark silhouette, same 2–3 flat tones per material, collar and gold clasp, short shoulder cap without full arms, left purple instrument strap, black round-dial instrument, teal connector and badge, looped aqua cord, glimpse of mint front ribbon and dark checked vest, dark shorts, visible knee, high charcoal sock. Keep the entire coat length and natural loose volume; no waist cinching. Preserve the existing palette and simplified internal line treatment.
No head, no face, no hair, no full arms or hands, no additional objects, no background, no shadow, no text. One isolated sprite. Genuinely transparent RGBA background and clean alpha.
